entities.summary: The Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS) is a public autonomous university in Singapore. Established in 2017, SUSS focuses on applied degree programmes primarily in the social sciences. In 2017, SUSS received its inaugural class of 2,137 graduates. Singapore University of Social Sciences is a university in Asia, established in 1994. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
